summary: WeShop Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 29, 2026, announcing a U.S. launch of its free community-owned shopping app on November 16, 2026, following a UK pilot generating £108.5M in GMV. The filing describes the ShareBack rewards and WePoints program allowing members to earn Class A ordinary share exposure, plus forward-looking statements and incorporation by reference into a Form S-8. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or structural deal mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary product-launch current report, not a special situation; watch only for launch execution and loyalty-market adoption.
